name: Spectre
source:
The Whimsical Watcher of the city

A mascot character responsible for monitoring Noise Scramble City.
He convinces Zena and the others not to leave.
He claims that if everyone tries to force their way out of the city, it will force a reset...?

"Noise——ish！ Leave it to me!"

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
